sentences.text: How do airplanes stay up?
Are we there yet?

header.text: An exclamation is like a statement, but it shows surprise or strong feeling. It ends with an exclamation point.

sentences.text: There's a turtle in the road!
Today is Rosa's birthday!

header.text: A command tells someone to do something. Most of the time, a command ends with a period. If it shows strong feeling, it ends with an exclamation point.

sentences.text: Put your shoes on.
Be nice to your sister!

header.text: The sentence is a command. It tells someone to do something. It should end with a period or an exclamation point.

contents.text: Don't step in the mud!
